triples.tail_surface: Never put grease on the sliding surfaces! They must be completely dry, dust-free and clean during the mounting procedure. Also any fingerprints shall be removed with alcohol or another suitable solvent.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安装期间保持干燥无尘清洁并用酒精或溶剂去除指纹
triples.evidence_text: NOTE: Never put grease on the sliding surfaces! They must be completely dry, dust-free and clean during the mounting procedure. Also any fingerprints shall be removed with alcohol or another suitable solvent.

triples.tail_surface: turned after installation... turn the shaft about 10 revolutions - with water in the pump - but without adding pressure
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安装后带水无压转动轴约10圈
triples.evidence_text: NOTE: ELK shaft seals must be turned after installation. So O-rings, springs and sliding surfaces can slip into right placement before pressure testing. This is done by mounting the seal as described and later turn the shaft about 10 revolutions - with water in the pump - but without adding pressure.

triples.tail_surface: pressure test the pump as normally done
triples.evidence_text: Then pressure test the pump as normally done.
